## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Contents"`

::: {.index}

```{r}
#| label: toc-decks
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "toc.R"))
knitTocContents(root,
  scope = if (exists("TOC.scope", inherits = FALSE)) TOC.scope else "main",
  language = if (exists("TOC.language", inherits = FALSE)) TOC.language else "en")
```

:::
